svg.title: Evaporation in open and sealed containers
svg.desc: (a) In an open container of water, a few of the fastest molecules escape the surface and leave. (b) In a sealed container, vapor builds up above the water until as many molecules condense, some of them on the walls and lid, as evaporate. An animated companion below illustrates the process; its complete static alternative is shown for reduced motion and print.

g.text: Equal mean escape and return rates
Schematic ensemble at fixed temperature. Saturation means zero net exchange, not stationary
